verdict.rationale: Dropbox Dash is presented as a first-party AI surface that gives "clear answers" across team knowledge. Dash resource pages cover summarizing files, getting AI answers from documents, reviewing documents and AI-assisted organization, so ask and summarize appear to exist. However, the homepage says "AI is coming to Dropbox" with summarization and intelligent organization, which leaves shipped-versus-announced status ambiguous, and the evidence is marketing and how-to material rather than feature documentation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of general availability, product documentation of the ask/summarize/extract features, any evidence of structured extraction, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
